title: Read-only diagnostics and validation
objective: Implement doctor and validate as read-only diagnostics for runtime, Git/gh authentication, Agent paths/capabilities, config/schema, versions, permissions, and installation integrity.
expected_output: doctor and validate commands with text/JSON diagnostics
acceptance_criteria: Doctor/validate report OS/runtime, Git/gh auth, Agent paths/capabilities, config/schema, versions, permissions, and integrity.
Both commands are read-only and perform no hidden mutation.
undo_classification: Revert only diagnostics code introduced by this node.
retry_policy: Initial attempt plus at most 2 retries; repeated integrity failure escalates without destructive retry.
